research_scope: 真实轨道驱动 Starlink + OneWeb NGSO 下行馈电共信道干扰管理，附加 GSO 接收地球站 EPFD↓ 风险监测；暂不引入用户 QoS/需求模型

reference_paper.title: Time-Continuous Frequency Allocation for Feeder Links of Mega Constellations with Multi-Antenna Gateway Stations
reference_paper.reference_model_note: 论文使用构造的Starlink Gen1+Gen2 34396星、115 MAGS；本配置不声称复现其地理/轨道数据

data_status_not_verified_by_config.caution: 候选数非活动链路数；OneWeb冻结基线6站均有FCC坐标来源（已补Clewiston和Santa Paula），全量扩展为6个FCC+7个区域仿真位置；许可不等于当前运营。GSO频段/波束仍需逐站核实。

beam_and_noise_common.path_loss: free_space_loss_only in paper-matched core (no precipitation/atmospheric loss)
beam_and_noise_common.polarization_and_aclr: assumed full cochannel coupling and ideal zero adjacent channel leakage in paper-matched core
beam_and_noise_common.uniform_parameters_between_operators: yes; a normalized research assumption, not verified actual Starlink/OneWeb equipment data
beam_and_noise_common.gateway_order_policy: gateway ID ascending, fixed order every round; satellite ID ascending breaks equal-elevation ties; same operator only

frozen_main_800mhz.notes: 保留当前UI；不是论文500MHz参数；不暗示每个实际网关已经获授权使用全部子信道

paper_bandwidth_adapted_500mhz.notes: 沿用论文总带宽500MHz和C=Nat但保持研究频率18.2GHz，因此不是严格照搬20GHz

paper_physics_reference_20ghz.role: strict_paper_physical_parameter_control_only; not an asserted common licensed frequency band
paper_physics_reference_20ghz.notes: 论文Table I的20GHz+500MHz；星座和网关依然不同，不能声称复现整篇论文实验

interference_core.signal_path: each active satellite transmitter points at its own serving gateway; each gateway receive antenna points at its serving satellite
interference_core.cross_path_formula: I[j->i]=Ptx_j * Gtx_j(offaxis from its own served gateway toward victim gateway i) * Grx_i(offaxis from served satellite i toward interfering satellite j) * (lambda/(4*pi*d_j_to_gateway_i))^2
interference_core.aggregate_power: sum linear Watts over cochannel satellite j != i above victim gateway horizon
interference_core.lf_definition: aggregate I/N strictly greater than -12.2 dB; denominator all active NGSO feeders
interference_core.graph_edge_method: per-victim adaptive threshold as paper Eq.(6)-(7); directed interference strengths retained; undirected edge if either victim suffers strong interference
interference_core.power_spectral_density_model: flat power per active full subchannel; scale Ptx by Br/B_subchannel when calculating EPFD in reference bandwidth

gso_protection_separate_from_ngso_lf.gso_receiver_boresight: from fixed reference receive station toward paired GSO satellite, not fixed horizontal antenna direction
gso_protection_separate_from_ngso_lf.epfd_formula: sum over simultaneously transmitting NGSO satellites in matching reference bandwidth: (P_j_ref_W*G_tx_j / (4*pi*d_jGSO_earth_station^2)) * (G_GSO_rx(offaxis)/G_GSO_rx_peak)
gso_protection_separate_from_ngso_lf.individual_constellation_and_combined_ag: report both; formal compliance requires applying the relevant single-entry and aggregate limits in the actual regulatory context
gso_protection_separate_from_ngso_lf.two_hour_stage: report instantaneous EPFD time series, worst-case and 100% line exceedances, explicitly as screening only
gso_protection_separate_from_ngso_lf.long_term_stage: generate representative long-run EPFD distribution and follow ITU-R S.1503 rather than claiming 2h proves formal compliance
gso_protection_separate_from_ngso_lf.limits_verification_status: UNVERIFIED_CANDIDATE_VALUES; do not apply as authoritative limits before checking original table/bandwidth/antenna/percentage semantics

paper_algorithm_reference.link_continuity_logic: same satellite+same gateway in neighboring epochs means inherited frequency opportunity
paper_algorithm_reference.frequency_switching_rate: changes on retained satellite-gateway feeder links / retained links over consecutive slots
paper_algorithm_reference.tcfa_penalty_tuning: not fully specified as a scalar default in Table I; select with documented sweep
paper_algorithm_reference.execution_time_reporting: hardware, programming language, parallelism and dataset scale must be disclosed; paper ms results not directly transferable
pending_implementation_parameters: antenna beamwidth and sidelobe free parameters

experiment_plan.step0_10s_single_snapshot: verify orbital positions, active assignments, EIRP, FSPL, off-axis angles, desired power, all interference matrices; compare in Watts before dB
experiment_plan.step1_720_slots: no allocation versus random, Global, GG, CTS; LF rate, conflicts, run time, fairness by operator
experiment_plan.step3_gso: EPFD screenings and cost of GSO protection; compliance percentages require multi-day simulation
experiment_plan.step4_scaling: increase real gateway-count scenario beyond 6+6 using verified or source-qualified real site locations; examine 4/8/16/25 antennas and frequency counts
experiment_plan.step5_ai: AI inference time plus update time versus classical baseline; do not include preprocessing ambiguously
